_about: Who sounds like what. Change a voice, then run: npm run voices -- --redo  (on GitHub: edit this file and the clips are remade automatically)

elevenlabs._voices: voice_id comes from elevenlabs.io > Voices. Pick any voice there (the Voice Library has Arabic and child-like voices), copy its ID and paste it here.

_pronounce: If a clip sounds wrong (for example a single sound read as a letter name), add the text here with a spelling that reads better, then remake it.
